title: Mexedrone

attribution.author: Josie Kins

notes.overview: Effects vary widely by individual, dose, and context.

effects.name: Euphoria
effects.description: Mild emotional euphoria and feelings of happiness are present within mexedrone and are likely a direct result of serotonin and dopamine release.

effects.name: Sedation
effects.description: The biggest difference between mexedrone and mephedrone is that it primarily results in moderate sedation over stimulation and can therefore discourage physical activities such as running, dancing or climbing.

effects.name: Spontaneous tactile sensations
effects.description: The "body high" of mexedrone can be described as a mild soft and warm tingling sensation that encompasses the entire body. This sensation maintains a consistent presence that steadily rises with the onset and hits its limit once the peak has been reached.

effects.name: Vibrating vision
effects.description: At high doses, a person's eyeballs may begin to spontaneously wiggle back and forth in a rapid motion, causing the vision to become blurry and temporarily out of focus. This is a condition known as nystagmus.

effects.name: Teeth grinding
effects.description: This component can be considered to be less intense when compared with that of MDMA.
